verdict.rationale: Deel runs a founders track that lists founder-relevant visas, including H-1B, L-1, E-2, O-1A, EB-1A and EB-2 NIW. It also mentions sponsoring work permits through your own entities, which implies a startup could petition for its founder. However, none of the evidence documents how founder self-sponsorship actually works. Missing for 10: beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer-control arrangements, coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance, any founder-specific petitioning documentation, and independent corroboration.
